segments.name: Digital assets
segments.description: A shell-like digital asset company that previously mined Bitcoin, holds a Dogecoin treasury, and is expanding into AI computing and GPU server infrastructure.
segments.evidence: In July 2025, we established a dedicated Dogecoin treasury program as part of our digital-asset strategy.

revenueModel.text: The company earned revenue from Bitcoin mining production and sales of cryptocurrency miners, but generated no revenue in fiscal 2026 after ceasing mining operations.
revenueModel.evidence: we expect our results of operations to continue to be affected by the Bitcoin price as all our revenue has been from Bitcoin mining production.

changes.text: In 2022 the company sold its subsidiaries WVM Inc. and China Silanchi Holding Limited and exited its former VIE structure.
changes.evidence: On April 27, 2022, as approved by a majority of shareholders in a special meeting of shareholders, we completed a disposition in which we sold all the equity interest in its subsidiaries WVM Inc. and China Silanchi Holding Limited for a total price of US$1,000,000 pursuant to a share purchase agreement dated March 31, 2022.

changes.text: In 2023 the company ceased all Bitcoin mining operations in the United States due to high operating costs.
changes.evidence: In December 2023, we ceased the operations of the miners in the Wyoming site in December 2023 due to the high operating costs in the United States.

changes.text: In 2025 the company established a Dogecoin treasury program and began expanding toward AI computing and digital infrastructure in 2026.
changes.evidence: In July 2025, we established a dedicated Dogecoin treasury program as part of our digital-asset strategy.
